title: [Supply Chain Security] Trivy and SBOM
description: Investigate a workload in the cluster that was flagged by the DevSecOps team for potential vulnerabilities. Your task is to generate a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) from the running Pod, identify vulnerable components, and patch the workload by updating the image to a secure version.

steps.title: Task: Investigate Insecure Workload with SBOM
